**1 — Scene:** Toast with butter portions, a small muffin, and tea. I exclude the toast on the separate rear plate.

**2 — Vessel:** The foreground plate appears to be a **20 cm side plate**, with area \(3.14 × 10² = 314\text{ cm²}\). The muffin sits separately on the tray; the tea is in a mug.

**3 — Items:** Approximately three overlapping toast slices, one small muffin, about six wrapped butter portions, and plain-looking tea. No visible added spread, milk, or sugar.

**4–7 — Area, volume, weight, and energy:**

| Item | Area coverage / footprint | Gross volume calculation | Bulk density | Estimated weight | kcal/100 g | Energy |
|---|---|---|---|---:|---:|---:|
| Toast | ~75% of foreground plate = 236 cm² | 236 × 1.5 cm average pile height = 354 ml | 0.30 g/ml, using bread-loaf density | 106 g | 280 | 297 kcal |
| Small muffin | ~33 cm² on tray | 33 × 3.5 cm = 116 ml | 0.45 g/ml | 52 g | 400 | 208 kcal |
| Butter portions | Outside plate; approximately six packets | Estimated contents: 6 × 10 ml = 60 ml | 0.95 g/ml | 57 g | 720 | 410 kcal |
| Tea | Mug interior ~7 cm diameter | 38.5 cm² × 5.7 cm liquid depth ≈ 220 ml | 1.0 g/ml | 220 g | 1 | 2 kcal |

The toast coverage adds to **75% of the foreground plate**; the remaining items are outside it. Butter weight estimates the packaged contents, not the wrappers.

**8 — Sanity check:** About **106 g of toast** is plausible for three slices, and **52 g** fits the small muffin. Estimated total is **435 g including tea**, or **215 g excluding tea**, and approximately **920 kcal** if all the butter is eaten. Butter portion size is the largest uncertainty.
